Name: F-SV NO Bowlegs
Author: Flumme
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#ff7700][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]
Sorry: This Mod is NOT up-to-date and will NOT be updated![/color][/b][/size][/color]


[color=#3c78d8]F-SV NO Bowlegs anymore [/color][size=2][color=#3c78d8](almost all characters)[/color]
[/size][/b][/size]

Same with all my little mods: I made this for a friend & me, but than I decided to publish it.

[b]I removed the bowlegs at almost all characters. Sometimes I keep a "small bowleg" when I thought it would fit better with the character. [/b]And sometimes the character don't have a bowleg when they stand, but when they walk they have a small one. I thought this would look a bit more realistic. I dit NOT changed something else, [u][b]ONLY[/b][/u] the bowlegs / foot.

I dit not changed all characters. This characters I dit [color=#ff0000][size=3][b]NOT[/b][/size][/color] changed: [i]Dana, George, Grandpa, Jas, Junimo, Krobus, maleRival, MrQi, Pierre, Robin, Robot, Sebastian, Wizard[/i].
I dit not changed the babies & children. Please take a look to this wonderful mod from [u][i]lakoria[/i][/u] if you want to change them, too: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/552/?]Babies & Toddler Remake
[/url]

In the image section you see a few pic's with the changes. On the left side the Original character, on the right side the changed character. At the character [b]Elliott[/b] you see the changed frontview and the [color=#ff0000][b]not[/b][/color] changed backview. Elliott is a slim man and it's ok if you see his slender legs sometimes. 

This mod was made in one long session, so there could be a few errors. If you find one: I'm really sorry, please report them. I will try to make a correction.



I give a lot of * Hugs * to my soul-sister [b]Acerbicon[/b]: Thanks for the great time in chat & teamspeak. I'm in love with all of your mods: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38816245/?tb=mods&pUp=1]Ace's mods - take a look![/url].

You should also take a look here: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/forums/stardew-valley.72/]Best Stardew Valley forum![/url][url=http://https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-seasonal-immersion.125683/]
[/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1421/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D1421&pUp=1]
[/url]

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

- First: Make please a backup from all your original / default files in the folder: Content/Characters (there where you have installed the game).

- Than take a look to the .png files in my ziped mod: Witch character you want to change?

- If you want to change them all, just overwrite the files in the Content/Characters folder of the game with [b]my[/b] .xnb files. The .png picture-files in my ziped folder are just for you to see the changes. They have no other use.

(to [b]uninstall[/b] please delete my files and add the default files back into the folder)


[b]Greetings and THANKS :)[/b]
